title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. translated_title: Openhagen Worlds：用于测量与训练科学发现智能体的校准环境
translated_abstract: 从事科学研究的智能体必须选择有信息量的实验并根据结果进行推理，但大多数科学发现基准无法将这种能力与记忆回溯、未明确说明的评分规则或捷径策略区分开来。我们提出Openhagen Worlds，一套包含27个程序化生成环境的基准套件（部分环境具有有限真值空间），涵盖从经典的实验推理谜题到基于模拟器的物理和化学场景。在这些环境中，智能体在预算限制下开展实验并提交答案，由确定性验证器对照隐藏真值进行检查。每个观测都标明了完整的评分规则，178个难度级别中的每一级都经过校准：只有在64个开发实例上，脚本化神谕策略成功率至少达到0.75、最强的合理非演绎策略成功率至多0.25、且每个受控捷径策略成功率至多0.35时，该级别才会被采纳。92个核心级别涵盖全部27个环境族，其规模适合训练小型模型；86个前沿级别……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Openhagen Worlds是一套包含27个程序化生成环境、178个经严格校准难度级别的科学发现基准套件，通过明确的评分规则和针对神谕策略、非演绎策略及捷径策略的成功率校准，能够真正测量并训练智能体选择信息性实验和从结果中推理的能力，排除记忆回溯与捷径策略的干扰。
en_tdlr: Openhagen Worlds is a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments with 178 rigorously calibrated difficulty levels that measure and train scientific discovery agents' ability to choose informative experiments and reason from results, while explicitly ruling out recall, unstated scoring rules, and shortcut policies.
